scope.summary: Quantum sensing is represented as a compact measurement-chain fixture.
included: Measurement-chain elements and one currentness claim

domain_profile.rationale: The field is mediated by instruments and calibration practices.

presentation.thesis: Quantum sensing claims become legible as a measurement chain.
presentation.rationale: The path follows how a physical quantity becomes a reviewed estimate.
presentation.alternatives_considered: A glossary-only report was rejected because it hides relation and evidence support.

sections.title: Measurement Chain
sections.purpose: Introduce the public narrative used by conformance scoring.
sections.body_markdown: A physical quantity is encoded, calibrated, and estimated under a reviewed warrant.

literature_ladder.read_for: How physical quantities become estimated through a measurement chain.
literature_ladder.do_not_infer: That every sensor uses the same implementation.

field_elements.label: Physical quantity
field_elements.actual_form: A property made observable only through a measurement interaction.
field_elements.load_bearing_relations: The quantity must be encoded before it can be estimated.

field_elements.label: Calibration transfer
field_elements.actual_form: A procedure that carries source traceability into the sensor output.
field_elements.load_bearing_relations: Calibration qualifies the estimated physical quantity.

core_ideas.label: Physical quantity
core_ideas.description: The target quantity becomes legible through encoding and estimation.

methods.label: Calibration transfer
methods.description: Calibration carries traceability into the reported result.

evidence_standards.summary: Claims require reviewed support links in the fixture.
evidence_standards.claim_policy: Reviewed supports links need reviewed_at plus a locator or support note.

source_role_requirements.rationale: The fixture requires one foundation source.

sources.title: Quantum Sensing Explained
sources.why_it_matters: Explains the measurement chain used by the conformance fixture.

claims.statement: As of 2026-07-16, this fixture treats quantum sensing as a measurement-chain report contract.

evidence_links.support_note: The fixture source directly describes the measurement-chain framing.

temporal.rationale: The claim is explicitly dated for conformance scoring.
